description.value: The AI Security Platform secures the code AI writes, the agents it runs, and the applications it builds.
Snyk sells an AI security platform. It positions itself as an independent security layer that validates AI-generated code, governs development agents, and secures AI-native applications.
A developer-oriented cybersecurity company, specializing in securing custom-developed code. It was founded in 2015 out of Tel Aviv and London.
Snyk Limited is a developer-oriented cybersecurity company that secures custom code, open-source dependencies, and cloud infrastructure.
Snyk is a developer-focused security company. Its platform finds and helps fix vulnerabilities across open-source dependencies, proprietary code, containers, and infrastructure as code.
Snyk is a developer-focused security company founded in 2015.

product_description.value: Code security that validates AI-generated code, agent governance for AI development agents, AI application security for models, workflows, and agents in production, and agentic remediation that turns vulnerability backlogs into pull requests.

Security products designed to help software developers find weaknesses, violations, and vulnerabilities during development. Its vulnerability database records security issues found in open-source software libraries.

Snyk Code, a cloud-based, AI-powered static analysis platform that originated with the DeepCode acquisition, and a vulnerability database covering open-source libraries. Later acquisitions added cloud security posture management (Fugue), dynamic application security testing (Probely), and AI agent security (Invariant Labs).

Snyk Open Source is its flagship product. Snyk Code targets flaws in proprietary code, and Container, Infrastructure as Code, and Cloud products extend coverage. The company also runs a searchable vulnerability database.

business_model_description.value: Sells subscription SaaS, and its core revenue comes from per-developer seat pricing across tiered plans. Its developer-centric approach and plugins for popular dev tools set it apart from vendors that mainly target security teams.

customer_description.value: Trusted by the world's most innovative companies. Named customers include Twilio, Yalo, Snowflake, Jaguar Land Rover, LabelBox, Manulife, Spotify, Kroger, and Wex.
Named customers include Twilio, Yalo, Snowflake, Jaguar Land Rover, LabelBox, Manulife, Spotify, Kroger, and Wex. Testimonials come from Yalo, Okta, Seismic, Komatsu, and Skechers.
Named customers include Asurion, Google, Intuit, MongoDB, New Relic, Revolut, and Salesforce.

revenue.value: roughly $326M in ARR as of February 2026 (Sacra)
